3. This Court is of the view that it is open to the petitioner to file an application under Section 175(3)
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 equivalent to Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. as it is settled law that a writ petition seeking registration of an FIR is not to be entertained.
